_readme: Optional real recordings. Put files in public/audio/ and write their file names here (mp3 data renamed to .voice, so download managers such as IDM don't grab them as music downloads). Empty entries = synthesized sound is used (or, for the voice lines, the step is skipped). welcome / intro_* = the owner's welcome and his introductions of everyone around the fire (see src/game/intro/introScript.js); scenario_intro = the narrator introducing scenario 1 over a shot of everyone at the fire, at the end of the introductions. ghost_boo / ghost_giggle / scream_<owner|amir|alireza|amin> = scenario 1 (the sheet ghost), synthesized when empty. amir_party / amir_last / farajpour_thanks / farajpour_pickles = lines of errand 1 (shown as captions when empty). ghost_appear = the ghost coming out of the pickle jar and at the camp after it (parts of it: src/game/quest/JarScene.ts, CreepScene.ts, SplitScene.ts); ghost_split = the ghost tearing into four at the fire (a part of it: SplitScene.ts). friends_scared = the friends' fear, faint under the nearest ghost while you go and save them (parts of it: src/game/quest/CrossFight.ts). rescue_music = the music all through saving the friends, over and over (src/game/quest/CrossFight.ts). ghost_laugh_scary / ghost_whisper / luna_bark = a deep laugh, a whisper, Luna barking: not used for now (the ghost at the camp has only ghost_appear).
